world.name: Faerûn — The Sword Coast
world.description: The western frontier of Faerûn — crowded port cities, ruined kingdoms, and wild country between Neverwinter and Baldur's Gate. A classic D&D sandbox.
world.gmNotes: Demo world — export and replace with your own. Drill into Sword Coast North for the Session 1 area. Add your map PNG to assets/maps/faerun-sword-coast.png or paste any image URL on the world entity.

entities.name: Welcome to LoreWeaver
entities.description: This is sample data — a Forgotten Realms Sword Coast demo. Click map markers to explore. Navigable pins (regions & locations) zoom in. Other pins open details in the sidebar. Right-click the map to add entities; drag markers to reposition. Export via Worlds when you're ready to build your own campaign.

entities.name: Sword Coast North
entities.description: Wild country between Neverwinter and the Triboar trail — Phandalin, goblin-infested woods, and the lost mine of the Phandelver pact. The sample campaign plays here.
entities.gmNotes: Session 1 hub. Players arrive via Triboar Trail after the ambush.

entities.name: Neverwinter & Environs
entities.description: A rebuilding city on the Sword Coast's northern reach. Lord Neverember holds the title; the city holds its breath.
entities.gmNotes: Optional — party may start or resupply here.

entities.name: Waterdeep Environs
entities.description: The City of Splendors — trade hub of the coast. Most caravans south pass through its gates.
entities.gmNotes: Teaser pin — expand if your campaign goes south.

entities.name: Phandalin
entities.description: A frontier mining town rebuilt on the ruins of an older settlement. One inn, one shrine, too many secrets for its size.
entities.gmNotes: Party base after escorting Sildar. Redbrands control the town until dealt with.

entities.name: Triboar Trail
entities.description: The muddy trade road linking Neverwinter to the frontier. Wagons, bandits, and the site of Gundren's ambush.
entities.gmNotes: Opening encounter — Cragmaw goblins, dead horses, tracks to Cragmaw Hideout.

entities.name: Cragmaw Castle
entities.description: A ruined castle held by King Grol and his goblin band. Gundren Rockseeker is prisoner somewhere inside.
entities.gmNotes: Mid-act dungeon. Grol has Gundren and knows the Black Spider's identity.

entities.name: Wave Echo Cave
entities.description: The lost mine of the Phandelver's Pact — spellforge, riches, and a dragon that claimed it centuries ago.
entities.gmNotes: Final dungeon. Black Spider waits near the forge.

entities.name: Redbrand Hideout
entities.description: Cellars beneath Tresendar Manor on Phandalin's east hill. Glasstaff's thugs run their racket from here.
entities.gmNotes: First major dungeon in town. Nothic in the crevasse.

entities.name: Neverwinter
entities.description: Walls patched with new stone, markets slowly refilling. The city remembers the eruption and the plague — and watches every stranger.

entities.name: Gundren Rockseeker
entities.description: Dwarf prospector who hired the party to escort supplies to Phandalin. He rode ahead with Sildar — and vanished.
entities.gmNotes: Found wounded or dead depending on pacing. Knows about the mine's value.

entities.name: Sildar Hallwinter
entities.description: Human warrior of the Lords' Alliance. Gundren's traveling companion. Earnest, capable, eager to restore order to Phandalin.
entities.gmNotes: Rescued from Cragmaw Hideout. Offers reward for clearing goblins and finding Gundren.

entities.name: Toblen Stonehill
entities.description: Proprietor of the Stonehill Inn. Knows everyone's business and serves a decent stew.
entities.gmNotes: Rumor table — points party at Redbrands and Cragmaws.

entities.name: Glasstaff (Iarno Albrek)
entities.description: The Redbrands' leader — a disgraced Lords' Alliance wizard with a glass staff and ties to the Black Spider.
entities.gmNotes: May flee via secret door if losing. Carries coded messages.

entities.name: Venomfang
entities.description: A young green dragon who claimed Wave Echo Cave. Arrogant, greedy, and sorely underestimating adventurers.
entities.gmNotes: Can be fought, negotiated, or bypassed. Not the final boss.

entities.name: Lords' Alliance
entities.description: A coalition of cities — Neverwinter, Waterdeep, and others — pledged to mutual defense and trade. Sildar carries their banner.

entities.name: The Redbrands
entities.description: Phandalin's masked thugs. Protection rackets, intimidation, and a manor basement full of secrets.
entities.gmNotes: Clear them to win the town's trust.

entities.name: Cragmaw Tribe
entities.description: Goblinoids paid by the Black Spider to capture Gundren and guard the trail.

entities.name: Escort the Wagon
entities.description: Gundren hired the party to bring a wagon of supplies from Neverwinter to Phandalin. Simple job — until the trail.
entities.gmNotes: Framing quest. Transitions into goblin ambush.

entities.name: Find Gundren Rockseeker
entities.description: The dwarf who hired you is gone — taken by goblins or worse. Sildar wants him found.
entities.gmNotes: Tracks → Cragmaw Hideout → Castle.

entities.name: Deal with the Redbrands
entities.description: The town lives in fear of masked ruffians. Harbin won't act. Someone has to.
entities.gmNotes: Unlocks alliance with Phandalin NPCs.

entities.name: The Lost Mine
entities.description: Reclaim Wave Echo Cave from its occupiers and uncover what the Phandelver pact left behind.
entities.gmNotes: Final arc. Nezznar the Black Spider is the end villain.

entities.name: Gundren's Supply Wagon
entities.description: Mining gear, food, and tools bound for Barthen's Provisions in Phandalin. Still yours to deliver — if the horses survived.

entities.name: Phandalin Town Map
entities.description: A rough sketch from Toblen — inn, manor, shrine, and "avoid the Redbrands after dark."
entities.gmNotes: Optional prop for the table.

entities.name: Ambush on the Triboar Trail
entities.description: Goblin arrows from the trees. Two dead horses. Gundren and Sildar's trail leads into the woods — and a hidden goblin path.
entities.gmNotes: Classic opening set-piece.

entities.name: The Redbrand Occupation
entities.description: For months the Redbrands have controlled Phandalin through fear. The townmaster looks away; the townsfolk whisper.
